input: My primary button is orange #FF6B00 with 16px bold white text, and the focus ring is #93C5FD on a white background. Is it accessible?

checks.description: Quotes the calculated button text ratio (about 2.86:1)
Quotes the calculated focus ring ratio (about 1.8:1)
Explains that 16px bold is not large text and requires 4.5:1
Proposes an alternative (dark text or another color in hex)
